profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc is a public, for-profit company headquartered in Toronto, with ticker CLS and CIK number 0001030894. Its website describes the company as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions.

The company states that it engineers, designs, and manufactures what it calls the backbone of AI and cloud technology. It says it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud, and advances technologies in high-growth markets.
